authority.task: Parent authorization for constructive R5 theory only
authority.parallel_scope_change: No newly matched current-CR source history; source recovery/theory-handoff deltas; no inherited gate promotion.

exact_target.matrix: The real matrix whose entries are the exact values represented by the saved binary64 arrays K_diag, K_lower, K_upper in the prior HeIII primary NPZ.
exact_target.excluded_matrix: Unrounded K_HeI_diag + exact lambda_HeII diagonal sum; regenerated continuum or physical operator.
exact_target.reward_interpretation: Each saved RHS entry is an exact represented input. Kinetic columns inherit their original lambda*E formation rounding. Do not silently replace them by a new exact product and then reuse old all-time values as if inputs were unchanged.
exact_target.source: Exact saved pr104 source_z projection[1:] for each selected z; projection[0] retained separately as boundary-entry mass with zero RR reward.
exact_target.input_uncertainty: This finite represented problem does not absorb continuum, grid, native-provider, source-history or isotope-model errors.

parameters.horizon: T >= 0; analytic zero and infinity endpoints; finite clocks require 0<T<infinity
parameters.I: fixed inherited channel-specific ionization threshold in eV; I >= 0
parameters.encoded_gamma_rule: If gamma is rounded before solving, define it by its exact encoded value and recompute a=gamma*T/m. Do not retain ideal delta in the tail formula unless the equality is certified.

premises: K is a real finite tridiagonal Z-matrix: both off-diagonals <=0.
K is a nonsingular M-matrix; certify using a strict positive witness or rigorous positive tridiagonal pivots.
For quantitative residual certification choose h_i>0 and beta>0 such that K*h >= beta*h componentwise in exact arithmetic.
w_i>=0 and r_i>=0; all arrays finite and shape-aligned.
No substochastic row-sum assumption, p_infinity<=1 assumption, or physical source-time reconstruction.

formulas.name: reward
conclusions: F_r is continuously differentiable and nondecreasing

formulas.name: positive_recurrence
formulas.conclusion: All exact z_j and terms are nonnegative.

formulas.name: ideal_delta_tails
formulas.condition: Exact gamma equality to the ideal clock design is part of the target.

formulas.name: exact_horizon_bracket
formulas.condition: Q_minus,Q_plus are certified upper bounds on the corresponding tail probabilities and lie in [0,1).

formulas.name: uncertain_horizon_bracket
formulas.condition: A intervals and P_upper are certified for the same exact K,w,r; q_upper in [0,1); evaluate final endpoints outward.

formulas.name: clock_scalar_certificate
formulas.expression: If abs(Ahat-sum_j w^T*zhat_j)<=d_sum, then abs(A_m-Ahat)<=C_w*sum_j epsilon_j+d_sum
formulas.condition: All right-hand error quantities bounded upward, including dot products and accumulation.

formulas.name: all_time_certificate
formulas.condition: Phat approximates w^T*xhat_inf with certified scalar error d_inf; xhat_inf may be the unchanged saved solution.

formulas.name: time_bin
formulas.condition: Certified endpoints for the same inputs; negative proposed upper or lower>upper is a failure, not silently clipped.

formulas.name: bin_signed_ledger
formulas.expression: N=Delta_count; E=Delta_kinetic; photon=E+I*N; internal=-I*N; fast_electron_kinetic=-E; energy_sum=0

formulas.name: bin_interval_signs
formulas.expression: photon in [E_L+I*N_L,E_U+I*N_U]; internal in [-I*N_U,-I*N_L]; fast_electron_kinetic in [-E_U,-E_L]

formulas.name: SI_conversion
formulas.condition: Exact SI eV_J decimal; final rounding included; convert exactly once.

formulas.name: conditional_bin_average
formulas.condition: 0<=T1<T2<infinity, properly declared observation bin; label conditional pulse return, not actual continuous injection rate or pointwise rate.

formulas.name: general_cumulative_source
formulas.expression: f_r(u)=integral_0^u exp(-K*tau)*r d tau; Y_r(T)=n0^T*f_r(T)+integral_0^T b(s)^T*f_r(T-s) ds
formulas.condition: b is nonnegative and locally integrable; finite nonnegative vector source measures also allowed with Stieltjes integration.

formulas.name: fixed_shape_source
formulas.expression: If b(t)=w*q(t), then Y_r(T)=integral_0^T q(s)*F_r(T-s) ds, for zero initial population
formulas.condition: q>=0, q units s^-1; current q history absent. Scalar saved-pulse kernels only cover supplied fixed shapes, not arbitrary energy-time spectra.

formulas.name: convergent_clock_sequence
formulas.condition: Exact analytic computation; fixed T>0; example delta_m=m^(-1/4) for m>1. Fixed delta alone does not give convergence to F_r(T).

formulas.name: T_endpoint_limits
formulas.expression: For fixed m,delta: bracket endpoints ->0 as T->0+; bracket endpoints ->P_r as T->infinity
formulas.condition: Exact analytic gamma design; exact arithmetic. Numerical certificate widths need not vanish automatically.

numerical_certification_obligations: Pin source NPZ hashes and each adopted K, reward, source array identity; do not rebuild hazards.
Validate finite shape, sign and orientation; source boundary mass is not dropped from the outer pulse ledger.
Prove a strict positive M-matrix witness or positive exact/rigorously enclosed tridiagonal pivots; floating positive pivots alone are diagnostics.
For witness h, prove h>0 and a lower beta>0 for min_i (K*h)_i/h_i; retain witness identity and arithmetic mode.
Define exact target gamma and exact shift K+gamma*I independently of the factorization's rounded diagonal.
Residuals must be bounded against exact target B and exact intended RHS, including gamma*zhat_previous multiplication.
Propagate earlier recurrence errors using F13; final-step residual alone is insufficient.
Enclose each contraction, recurrence error sum and scalar dot/sum roundoff.
Certify P_upper using unchanged saved solutions plus residuals or a separately bounded valid all-time computation; never assume old binary64 answers exact.
Tail probabilities must have genuine upper bounds. Rounded log/exp or underflow to zero does not by itself prove q_upper.
Use actual a=gamma*T/m for rounded gamma; a_minus>1 and 0<a_plus<1 must hold exactly or be rigorously bounded.
Form all final bracket endpoints and signed linear maps with outward rounding; invalid interval ordering is a failed certificate.
If only nominal residuals/high-precision agreement are supplied, label numerical evidence diagnostic and keep rigorous floating certificate status unresolved.
Keep exact finite-K analytical error, arithmetic certificate, and inherited physical/model/grid errors separate.

references.proof_attribution: The exact finite-K lemmas and their current source binding are derived here; literature motivates general Markov reward/Erlang methods. No novelty claim.
